content:
iPhone 18 Pro is set to launch next month, and many iPhone users may be wondering: what's really different this year? Based on the latest rumours, here are some of the main ways Apple plans to differentiate the iPhone 18 Pro from previous models.

Major main camera upgrade

Apple upgrades the iPhone's camera system in various ways every year, but significant changes to the main camera are uncommon.

The iPhone 17 Pro brought a completely revamped front-facing camera and an improved telephoto lens. According to rumours, Apple will further upgrade the telephoto lens on the iPhone 18 Pro, with major changes also coming to the main camera. Leaker Fixed Focus Digital hinted at this recently.

He said the main camera upgrade for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup has been "confirmed" and will increase the thickness of the "aluminium alloy backplate" by more than 2mm. In other words, this year's camera bump may be thicker than previously rumoured. Why such a significant increase? In a follow-up post, the leaker attributed it to the "enlarged main camera module".

Mark Gurman has repeatedly stated that the iPhone 18 Pro will feature "one of the most significant camera hardware upgrades in the lineup's history". We expect a variable aperture feature to be added, but it sounds like there may be even more to this year's camera changes.

Apple's in-house C2 modem

Apple began its gradual move away from Qualcomm's 5G modem starting last year with the iPhone 16e, which featured the in-house C1 modem. The iPhone Air continued this trend with the C1X modem. However, Apple's most popular models — the iPhone 17 Pro, Pro Max and iPhone 17 — continued to use Qualcomm's solution.

Rumours suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will switch to Apple's in-house C2 modem, which is expected to bring the following advantages:

  • Improved battery efficiency
  • New privacy feature: "Restrict Precise Location"
  • More reliable connectivity in areas with weaker signals

Best battery life ever, with the iPhone 18 Pro Max standing out in particular

Partly due to the C2 modem and the all-new A20 Pro chip, the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to deliver the best battery life of any iPhone to date.

However, the iPhone 18 Pro Max should be even more impressive, as regulatory filings show its battery capacity will be roughly 10% larger than its predecessor's.

Last year's Pro Max model already offered impressive battery life, but the iPhone 18 Pro Max may push续航力 (battery life) to an entirely new level.

Design breakthrough: dark cherry colour and new Dynamic Island

Apple has historically avoided bold, vibrant colours on its Pro models, but last year's Cosmic Orange was a huge hit with iPhone 17 Pro buyers, breaking that convention.

As for the iPhone 18 Pro, the new flagship colour will be a dark cherry/wine red tone, which is expected to be equally popular. This will be the first time Apple has released a similar colour, and the first time a red tone has appeared on a Pro-series iPhone.

In addition, an all-new Dynamic Island design will debut on the iPhone 18 Pro, with the area expected to be 35% smaller than the current Dynamic Island.
